items.html: And it is found that the Land of Israel, which was opposite Yetzirah, does not receive from it except through Assiyah, since Yetzirah clothes in it. And likewise, Beriah clothes in Yetzirah, and the Nukva of Atzilut clothed in Beriah, and ZA clothed in his Nukva. And likewise, in this manner, in all the upper ones above him, all of them descended from their degree.
